subject: Scheduling: Solutions Engineering deep dive & security walkthrough — FinLytics
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Jul 19, 2026 at 09:12 AM EDT
Subject: Scheduling: Solutions Engineering deep dive & security walkthrough — FinLytics

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the quick discovery call earlier. As discussed, the next step is a technical deep dive led by our Solutions Engineering team plus a short security walk-through for your InfoSec. Proposed goals: review integration options, live inference demo with a sample prompt set, and cover security/controls and evidence requirements.

Attendees we plan to have: Karthik (SE), Vivek (SE backup), myself + Marissa (AE), and Kimberly (Product Security). From your side you mentioned engineers and InfoSec — please confirm final attendee list.

Suggested blocks (all listed in ET / PT):
- Tue, Jul 20 — 11:00–12:30 ET (8:00–9:30 PT) — 90m deep dive + Q&A
- Wed, Jul 21 — 11:00–12:30 ET (8:00–9:30 PT) — 90m deep dive + security walkthrough
- Wed, Jul 21 — 14:00–15:30 ET (11:00–12:30 PT) — 90m (alternate for east-coast mornings)

If InfoSec prefers a shorter focused evidence review we can split into a 60m tech deep dive and a 30m evidence/pricing follow-up (back-to-back or separate). I attached a short agenda for the deep dive (SE-demo-agenda.pdf).

Please let us know: (1) which of the slots works for your engineers and Tom from InfoSec, (2) whether you prefer a split cadence (60 + 30), and (3) if there are calendar or corporate constraints (e.g., procurement needing a separate attendee).

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego: +1 415-555-0187

Attachments: SE-demo-agenda.pdf (agenda, 1 page)
From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@finlytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@finlytics.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, Jul 19, 2026 at 11:04 AM EDT
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Solutions Engineering deep dive & security walkthrough — FinLytics

Diego — thanks, that agenda looks good. Quick notes from our side:

- Attendees: me (Staff Eng), Tom Liu (InfoSec lead), Raj Patel (Procurement) — Raj may not join the deep technical session but will want to join any procurement/pricing follow-up.
- Time constraints: Tom is only available in the morning Eastern time on Tue/Wed (before 11:30 ET) due to regional security reviews. If the deep dive runs 90m it must start no later than 10:00 ET for him to attend.
- We'd prefer a split cadence: 60m technical deep dive (SE + engineers) followed by a separate 30m procurement/pricing call later the same day or next day.
- Attached: our security questionnaire (security-questionnaire.xlsx) — Tom asked that you confirm where we can upload evidence and what format you prefer.

Proposed realistic slot from our side if split:
- Wed, Jul 21 — 10:00–11:00 ET (7:00–8:00 PT) — 60m technical deep dive
- Wed, Jul 21 — 11:30–12:00 ET — 30m procurement/pricing (can be separate invite)

Can Karthik or Vivek do an early ET start?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Jones | Staff Engineer, FinLytics
Attachments: security-questionnaire.xlsx (Excel, 14 rows)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@finlytics.com>; Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Jul 19, 2026 at 12:28 PM EDT
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Solutions Engineering deep dive & security walkthrough — FinLytics

Agree with the split approach — that reduces cognitive load for InfoSec and makes procurement a focused conversation for Raj.

A couple quick asks from our side:
- If you confirm the sample prompt set and a minimal dataset for the live demo, we can prep a short sandbox for the session. Karthik — can you confirm the access steps?
- Diego — we'll send a separate invite for the procurement 30m slot; please hold 11:30–12:00 ET on Jul 21 as tentative until Raj confirms.

Tentative (hold):
- Deep dive: Wed Jul 21, 10:00–11:00 ET
- Procurement: Wed Jul 21, 11:30–12:00 ET

I'll echo calendar holds after internal alignment.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Jones <alice.jones@finlytics.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Jul 20, 2026 at 08:15 AM EDT
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Solutions Engineering deep dive & security walkthrough — FinLytics

Thanks team — I can do the Wed Jul 21 10:00–11:00 ET slot (that’s 7:00–8:00 PT for me) but it’s an early call; happy to take it if needed. Vivek is available a little later and can cover if this conflicts with other commitments.

Logistics for the deep dive:
- Please share the sample prompt set (5–10 prompts) and one example input file if you want us to demo fine-tuned behavior.
- We'll need a technical contact with VPN/access to whitelisted IPs only if you want us to hit a private endpoint; otherwise we can demo against a sandbox environment.
- I'll upload a short runbook for session prep (access-checklist.md) to the shared Drive link.

If Tom from InfoSec wants the evidence bundle pre-session, Kimberly and I can prepare the SOC2/controls summary and a short mapping to your questionnaire. Otherwise we can walk through it during the 30m follow-up.

-Karthik
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@finlytics.com>

Karthik / team — that works, thanks. We prefer the sandbox demo (no need to whitelist internal endpoints for this first call). We'll send a 5–7 prompt set by EOD Tue Jul 20 (ET).

Confirmed attendees for the deep dive: Alice Jones (Staff Eng), Tom Liu (InfoSec) — Tom will join the first 45–60m and step out if the session runs long. Engineers: Samir Das and Mei Chen (both joining).

Procurement: Raj will tentatively join for 11:30–12:00 ET on Jul 21. If anything changes I’ll let you know.

Thanks — we’ll accept the Wed Jul 21 10:00–11:00 ET deep dive and the 11:30–12:00 ET procurement slot.

Alice

Subject: Confirmed: Wed Jul 21 — SE deep dive 10:00–11:00 ET / procurement 11:30–12:00 ET

Great — thank you all for the quick turnaround and clear attendee list. I’ve sent two calendar invites to the confirmed attendees (links below) and marked the procurement slot tentative for Raj until he accepts.

Final details:
- Deep dive (60m): Jul 21, 10:00–11:00 ET (7:00–8:00 PT) — Karthik leading the demo, Vivek on standby. Sandbox environment will be used; Alice will upload the 5–7 prompt set to the Drive link below.
- Procurement (30m): Jul 21, 11:30–12:00 ET — Marissa/Diego + Raj for pricing/PO questions.
- Pre-reads and attachments uploaded: SE-demo-agenda.pdf, access-checklist.md, security-questionnaire.xlsx (from FinLytics).
